RELIANCE.title: Q4 FY24 Earnings Report - Reliance Industries Limited
RELIANCE.excerpt: Consolidated net profit increased 19% YoY driven by robust O2C (Oil-to-Chemical) margin recovery, double-digit ARPU expansion in telecom (Jio), and 24% square footage growth in retail network.

RELIANCE.title: Exchange Filing - Reg 30 Material Event Disclosure
RELIANCE.excerpt: Discloses capital allocation of Rs 75,000 Cr for renewable energy gigafactories in Jamnagar. Net debt to EBITDA remains comfortable at 0.72x with average debt maturity profile of 6.8 years.

RELIANCE.title: Analyst Note - ICICI Securities Institutional Research
RELIANCE.excerpt: Energy segment margins exhibit strong refining spread stability. However, consolidated valuation multiples (EV/EBITDA at 12.8x) trade near the +1.5 standard deviation historical band.

TCS.title: Q4 FY24 Audited Financial Statement - Tata Consultancy Services
TCS.excerpt: Constant currency revenue growth stood at 3.5% YoY with operating margin expanding 150 bps to 26.0%. Order book Total Contract Value (TCV) reached an all-time record of $13.2 Billion.

TCS.title: SEBI Corporate Governance Report - FY24
TCS.excerpt: Attrition moderated further to 12.5% LTM. Board approved dividend payout ratio of 82% of net income with zero long-term debt on standalone balance sheet.

TCS.title: Kotak Institutional Equities Sector Outlook - Indian IT
TCS.excerpt: Discretionary IT spending in North American BFSI client base shows nascent green shoots, though deal cycle duration remains extended compared to historical averages.

INFY.title: Q4 FY24 Investor Presentation - Infosys Limited
INFY.excerpt: FY25 constant currency revenue guidance pegged at 1.0% to 3.0% with operating margin band guided between 20.0% and 22.0%. Large deal TCV came in at $4.5 Billion for the quarter.

INFY.title: SEBI Shareholding Pattern & Insider Trading Report
INFY.excerpt: Zero promoter pledge. FII holding stabilized at 33.8% following consecutive quarters of marginal outflow.

INFY.title: Motilal Oswal Institutional Research - IT Services
INFY.excerpt: Subdued near-term discretionary enterprise budgets in Europe offset by solid generative AI delivery pipeline (Topaz platform adoption up 40% QoQ).

HDFCBANK.title: Q4 FY24 Financial Results - HDFC Bank Limited
HDFCBANK.excerpt: Net Interest Margin (NIM) stabilized at 3.44% on total assets (3.63% on earning assets). Gross NPA maintained at 1.24% with provision coverage ratio (PCR) healthy at 74.0%.

HDFCBANK.title: RBI / SEBI Merger Harmonization & Compliance Disclosure
HDFCBANK.excerpt: Post-merger Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio systematically moderated from 110% towards 104% through aggressive retail deposit mobilization (up 26.4% YoY).

HDFCBANK.title: Axis Capital Banking Desk Review
HDFCBANK.excerpt: Core retail franchise strength continues to outpace private sector peers. Price-to-Adjusted Book Value (P/ABV) of 2.4x is at a 5-year cyclical low, offering attractive risk-adjusted margin of safety.
